newsitem.title: USA: COMSAT Corp teams with Cortelco.
newsitem.headline: COMSAT Corp teams with Cortelco.

text.p: COMSAT RSI Plexsys Wireless Systems, a division of COMSAT Corp, said Wednesday it has established a teaming agreement with Cortelco to pursue joint opportunities in wireless private branch exchange systems.
The joint projects are to be geared toward providing business customers mobile telephone systems for office and home.
"This opens up a larger market for both companies," said Doss McComas, chief executive of COMSAT RSI Plexsys Wireless Systems. He declined to speculate how the move will effect company profits.
